rca of the issue: Repro: login as admin -> open /ghg/scope1 -> open an existing emission edit record. Observed repeated runtime console entries: REQUEST FAILED ... net::ERR_ABORTED for customer-assets logo and cdn-cgi/rum endpoints. Likely root cause is unstable/non-critical asset telemetry requests during route transitions; even though core edit flow works, this fails strict no-console-error acceptance.
